englishAudio.text: I will inspect the repaired area.

englishAudio.text: The pressure slowly drops. Min records it and stops the equipment.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: It has not passed. We did not repair it well.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: Do not jump to a conclusion. We still need to check.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: I want it to pass. But wishes are not evidence.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: The pressure changed. I do not yet know why.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: I wanted you to say it passed. But you did not lie.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: I am afraid that if I cannot repair it, no one will want my help anymore.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: I cannot promise it will pass. But I will check it with you.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: Min slowly nods. I wait patiently, without answering for him.

englishAudio.text: We test it before we trust it. First check the equipment, then the repaired pipe.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: First, inspect the equipment hose.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: An, please check it too.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: I can see it now. The equipment hose is not connected properly. The leak is here, not at the new joint.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: Finding a fault here does not mean everything else passes. After fixing it, we must test again.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: The equipment hose is not connected properly. Its fault affects the reading too.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: Then we still do not know whether the repaired pipe passes.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: This section passes. But it still needs cleaning, and the water must pass its own checks before anyone drinks it.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: It is not that I am a failure. There is still something to repair?
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: We must honor our earlier promises about sharing water. We record it first, without distributing it in secret.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: All right. The pipe is still shut. Today, we have two more buckets of drinking water.
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.text: What did we gain today?
englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudio.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.
